title: Add GitHub Actions deploy workflow for web and infra
description:
GitHub Actions only — no AWS CodePipeline (no idle pipeline cost, matches existing CI).

OIDC role in CDK for GitHub to assume. Workflow:
- develop merge -> npm run build in web/ -> cdk deploy ChatticusWeb (and thin-turn stack if API wiring changed).
- main merge -> staging stacks.
- production: workflow_dispatch gated (same as thin-turn production).

Phase 1 can be workflow_dispatch + manual cdk deploy; OIDC can be a sub-task if needed.
